audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names Hwei's E as "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" — that ability does not exist in his kit. His crowd-control spell tree is E, Subject: Torment (Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw).
audit.why: The brief's enemyAbilities and kit confirm the real slot names: P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. "Subject: Fear" is a fabricated composite.
audit.corrected: Replaced every instance of the fabricated name with Subject: Torment (E) across winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and report[9].t.

audit.why: Chart (Hwei favored levels 1-first item, Morgana favored 2+ items) matches the content-layer prose, which is already grounded and specific.
Level 6 (both ults) and first-item spikes are already correctly called out in spikes[].

edits.before: Referee the poke mirror with the shield. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Referee the poke mirror with the shield. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment (E), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.

edits.before: - Morgana vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Morgana vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: Subject: Torment (E) is 12s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — all his hard CC lives there. Once he's cast it, he's a pure poke mage for that window; your own Q is down 10s if you whiff into it.

edits.before: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and root discipline.
edits.after: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Torment (E) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and root discipline.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment (E) — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): all his CC lives here, 12s down to 10s cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime, not his poke's.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Bait the answer, then sign.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Bait the answer, then sign.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Trade in W range where his QW/QE combo can't reach — his Q variants have 0 base range, all delivered on-cast.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Standing at max range baiting his poke — every Q variant can be Wind-Wall-class blocked, but Morgana has no such tool, so eat it on cooldown.

notes: The page-wide fabricated ability name 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' does not exist in Hwei's kit — corrected to Subject: Torment (E), his real CC spell tree, everywhere it appeared. Level chart (Hwei favored through first item, Morgana favored at 2+ items) already agrees between full and content layers and matches the 52.32% overall win rate narrative, so left untouched.
